description.zh:
是否需要钉钉报警：

- true-需要
- false-不需要
description.en:
Specifies whether to send alerts through DingTalk. Valid values:

- true: yes

- false: no

description.zh:
是否配置邮件通知：

- true：已配置
- false｜null : 未配置
description.en:
Specifies whether to send alerts by email. Valid values:

- true: yes

- false or null: no

description.zh:
报警事件类型：

- ADDR_ALERT：地址不可用
- ADDR_RESUME：地址恢复可用
- ADDR_POOL_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE：地址池集合不可用
- ADDR_POOL_GROUP_AVAILABLE：地址池集合恢复可用
- ACCESS_STRATEGY_POOL_GROUP_SWITCH：主备地址池切换
- MONITOR_NODE_IP_CHANGE：监控节点IP地址变更
description.en:
The type of the alert event. Valid values:

- ADDR\_ALERT: An address becomes unavailable.

- ADDR\_RESUME: An address becomes available.

- ADDR\_POOL\_GROUP\_UNAVAILABLE: An address pool group becomes unavailable.

- ADDR\_POOL\_GROUP\_AVAILABLE: An address pool group becomes available.

- ACCESS\_STRATEGY\_POOL\_GROUP\_SWITCH: A switchover occurs between the primary and secondary address pools.

- MONITOR\_NODE\_IP\_CHANGE: The IP address of a monitoring node changes.

description.zh:
是否配置短信通知：

- true：已配置
- false｜null : 未配置
description.en:
Specifies whether to send alerts through text messages. Valid values:

- true: yes

- false or null: no
The alert contact group. The value is a JSON-formatted \`List\<string>\`.

description.zh:
CNAME接入域名类型：

- PUBLIC: 公网型
description.en:
The type of the CNAME record. Valid value:

- PUBLIC: The CNAME record is used for Internet access.

description.zh:
是否强制更新。

- true-强制更新，不进行冲突提示。
- false|null-不强制更新，若遇冲突则提示。
description.en:
Specifies whether to forcefully update the instance. Valid values:

- true: Forcefully updates the instance without checking for conflicts.

- false or null: Does not forcefully update the instance. The system checks for conflicts before the update.

description.zh:
GTM实例ID。<props="china">可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_8_8.2aea3618RlSR9K)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
description.en: The ID of the GTM instance. To obtain the instance ID, call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation.

description.zh: 实例名称：首次更新必填，再次更新则非必填。
description.en: The name of the instance. This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates.

description.zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja。
description.en: The language of the response. Valid values: en, zh, and ja. The default value is en.

description.zh:
公网域名接入方式：

- SYSTEM_ASSIGN:系统分配（此选项功能关闭）
- CUSTOM:自定义
description.en:
The method used to access the instance over the Internet. Valid values:

- SYSTEM\_ASSIGN: The system assigns a canonical name (CNAME) record. This option is disabled.

- CUSTOM: You specify a CNAME record.
The hostname of the CNAME record that is used for Internet access.
The service domain name that is accessed over the Internet.

description.zh:
CNAME接入域名（公网）：主域名，且当为自定义接入时为必填。

> 此处应填入主域名，不包含PublicRr参数内容
description.en:
The primary domain name that is used to access the instance over the Internet using a CNAME record. This parameter is required if you set PublicCnameMode to CUSTOM.

> Enter the primary domain name. Do not include the hostname specified by the PublicRr parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-dns-gtm-instance-global-config --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00 --instance-name test-1 --ttl 60 --public-cname-mode CUSTOM --public-user-domain-name example.com --public-zone-name www.example.com --alert-group test1_,_test2 --cname-type PUBLIC --alert-config EmailNotice=true SmsNotice=true NoticeType=ADDR_ALERT DingtalkNotice=true --public-rr test.rr --force-update true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDnsGtmInstanceGlobalConfig --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00' --AlertConfig.1.SmsNotice true --Lang en --PublicZoneName 'www.example.com' --Ttl 60 --AlertConfig.1.EmailNotice true --InstanceName 'test-1' --AlertGroup 'test1_,_test2' --CnameType PUBLIC --PublicUserDomainName 'example.com' --AlertConfig.1.NoticeType ADDR_ALERT --AlertConfig.1.DingtalkNotice true --PublicRr 'test.rr' --ForceUpdate true --PublicCnameMode CUSTOM
